description: lmbp conformance vectors. Keys are derived as SHA-256(label) used as Ed25519 seed. 'now' is the verification time (NumericDate). Implementations MUST verify every jws entry with the listed key/expectations and MUST reject every negative entry. Signers are not required to reproduce payload bytes exactly, but Ed25519 over signing_input with the given key MUST yield signature_b64url (Ed25519 is deterministic).
